items.title: Submit proof of use of loan funds (invoice or signed order from heating company)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.
items.computation: Start: letter date 21.11.2026 (a Saturday); period runs 'nach dem Briefdatum', so per §187 Abs.1 BGB the letter date itself is not counted, counting starts the next calendar day (22.11.2026, a Sunday). 'Arbeitstage' are defined by the letter as Monday to Friday, excluding statutory holidays. Counting only Mon-Fri days starting 22.11.2026: 23.11 (Mon, day1), 24.11 (Tue, day2), 25.11 (Wed, day3), 26.11 (Thu, day4), 27.11 (Fri, day5), 30.11 (Mon, day6, skipping Sat28/Sun29), 01.12 (Tue, day7), 02.12 (Wed, day8), 03.12 (Thu, day9), 04.12 (Fri, day10). No NW public holidays fall in this window. Day 10 = Friday 04.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further shift is needed.
